description: This file provides functions for loading, cropping, rendering, and closing images in an OpenGL context, utilizing the stb_image library for image loading and integrating with Lua state for scripting support.

methods.name: lu5_image * lu5_load_image(lu5_State * l5,const char * image_path)
methods.description: Loads an image file into an OpenGL texture, creates a lu5_image object, and stores it in the Lua state context.

methods.name: lu5_image * lu5_image_crop(lu5_State * l5,lu5_image * image,int x,int y,int w,int h)
methods.description: Creates a cropped version of an existing image by extracting a subsection from the original texture and creating a new texture for it.

methods.name: void lu5_render_image(lua_State * L,GLuint texture,lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders an image at specified position and size with a color tint in an OpenGL context.

methods.name: void lu5_close_image(lu5_image * image)
methods.description: Deletes the OpenGL texture associated with a lu5_image and frees its memory.

methods.name: void lu5_close_images(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Iterates through stored images in the Lua state and closes all of them.

ctags.name: lu5_image_crop
ctags.pattern: /^lu5_image *lu5_image_crop(lu5_State *l5, lu5_image *image, int x, int y, int w, int h) $/
ctags.signature: (lu5_State * l5,lu5_image * image,int x,int y,int w,int h)

ctags.name: lu5_render_image
ctags.pattern: /^void lu5_render_image(lua_State* L, GLuint texture, lua_Number x, lua_Number y, lua_Number w, lu/
ctags.signature: (lua_State * L,GLuint texture,lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lu5_color color)
